context:

   the relevant UnifiedExpr class that handles the platform dispatch.
   Each public method (year, month, day, hour, minute) becomes:
   `return self._extract_date_part("year")`.

   `return self._polars_window_rank("min", order_by, partition_by)`.

3. G16 - Aggregation dispatch:
   Add `_apply_aggregation(self, pyspark_fn, datafusion_fn, polars_method)`

   Each aggregation method becomes a one-liner.

4. G23 - Data loading:
   Extract shared logic into a standalone function
   `_load_tables_from_data_source_impl(ctx, data_dir, schema_info)`

description:
Wave-2 duplicate-check triage (2026-03-12) identifies 4 consolidation-worthy
groups in the DataFrame platform layer (unified_frame.py, polars_df.py,
expression_family.py, pandas_family.py). These are identical dispatch patterns
that vary only by the underlying function name or method parameter.

Targets (report rank → dup lines):

G7 (60 dup lines): day/hour/minute/year/month temporal extraction in
    unified_frame.py:585-649. 5 methods with identical multi-platform
    dispatch (PySpark → DataFusion → Polars fallback), differing only
    in the extraction function name (e.g., F.year vs F.month).

G10 (58 dup lines): window_rank/window_row_number/window_dense_rank in
    polars_df.py:532-591. 3 methods with identical pattern: unpack
    order_by → create Polars expression → apply rank with different
    method parameter ("min", "ordinal", "dense") → handle partition.

G16 (55 dup lines): max/mean/min aggregation methods in
    unified_frame.py:1018-1127. 6 copies with identical multi-platform
    dispatch for aggregations, differing only by the function name
    (F.sum, F.avg, F.min, F.max, etc.).

G23 (52 dup lines): load_tables_from_data_source in
    expression_family.py:1230 and pandas_family.py:1037. Identical
    data loading logic (resolve source → iterate tables → normalize
    paths → load) differing only by context type signature.

anti_patterns.dont: merge expression_family and pandas_family into one class
use getattr-based dynamic dispatch for the aggregation helper
anti_patterns.why: pass explicit function references to maintain IDE navigability and type safety

preserves.behavior: Aggregation methods dispatch correctly across PySpark, DataFusion, and Polars
All temporal extraction methods return identical UnifiedExpr types
Data loading produces identical table_stats and loaded data for both families
Polars window functions produce identical rank semantics (min/ordinal/dense)
Type signatures on public methods remain compatible for callers
